breaking_changes.BC_description: Removed synchronous methods: `.renderSync()`, `.getTemplateDataSync()` and `.getJsdocDataSync()`. The jsdoc2md API is now async-only.
Changed mandatory options. Previously, either `option.files` or `option.source` was mandatory. Now, it is either `option.files`, `option.source` or `option.configure`.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: When calling jsdoc2md methods, ensure you provide at least one of the three options: `option.files`, `option.source`, or the new `option.configure`.
breaking_changes.RequireInfo: Additional details about the new `option.configure` parameter are needed. What is the expected type and structure of this parameter? Are there examples of how to use it correctly? How does it differ functionally from the other input options?
